decisions.quote: In contrast to the replicated CRP findings in females, regression models for IL-8 and IL-10 did not replicate, although post-hoc analyses did show that SUD+ females again exhibited higher IL-8 concentrations than SUD− females when covariates were not included.
decisions.reason: The study set out to replicate three female SUD biomarker findings from May et al. (2021) (lower CRP and higher IL-8 and IL-10 concentrations) and explicitly reports that while the CRP finding replicated, the omnibus regression models for IL-8 and IL-10 did not replicate. Under the codebook, confirming one tested effect while explicitly contrasting non-replicated effects yields a mixed outcome.
